title: Unstructured data processing workflow
description: Metadata for an unstructured data processing workflow folder. The presence of udp_workflow.yaml marks the folder as a workflow.

sample_tables.description: The samples tables that hold the workflow's sample files, each a fully qualified Unity Catalog table name.

genie_code_thread_id.description: ID of the Genie Code chat that created the workflow. Written by Databricks.

routers.description: How the workflow routes each class of documents to its own extraction, one entry per classification step. Only what the job's own settings can't show: the labels are the classification task's, and each extraction task is found by the table it reads.

pipeline_router.description: A classification task whose labels a pipeline task routes to a table per class.

type.description: How the documents are routed: a pipeline task after the classification task.

job.description: The bundle key of the job that runs both tasks (`resources.jobs.<job>`).

classify_task.description: The task key of the ai_classify task whose labels are routed.

route_task.description: The task key of the pipeline task that writes each class's documents to its own table.

routes.description: The table each label's documents are routed to. A label without a route here isn't declared, not unrouted.

label.description: A label of the classification task, as the task names it.

table.description: The `catalog.schema.table` the label's documents are routed to.

unmatched.description: What happens to a document that fits no label: `fail` fails the routing update, or the `catalog.schema.table` such documents go to.
